title: Solo pianists, king cake mule again and Punch Miller today
summary: He recalls hiring a piano man for king cake parties, later Punch and Rene getting stiffed, and Punch's drinking.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: No, that's all before my time. See I didn't come here until nineteen forty-five. I was in the Navy. Yes. Then I moved here to 49. So it's normal for my time. Yeah. Did they have many solo piano players around town? They had a few.

Yeah. Not too many. We had, uh, we used to hire a little nigga. And I can't recall his name for these king cake parties when I was a youngster. We used to get, give him and hire just a piano man to dance by, you know. Couldn't afford a band in those days. Kids, you know.

But after, in later years, when I, we started getting a little older, then that's when they started hiring bands like Punch and Rene. Yeah, I don't know if you get a lot out. And that's when they started putting the mule on the poor devils. Yeah. Many of them played for nothing. For drinks, that's all. Mm-hmm. Well they, they halfway expected it, Dick.
Well they just came to drink anyway, huh? Yeah, that's right. Yeah, that's right.
Yeah, and those Negroes used to like that soup out. Right. I guess Punch drank, drank plenty of licking his dead.
Yeah, he didn't touch it now.
No. I've never seen him take a drink of it.
He must be pretty old, Dick.
Yeah, he's got an old age pension. Mm-hmm. He's turned 65 since he came back.
